# AIDrift Manifest v1 Schema Reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:generate` from `AI_STATE_MANIFEST_SCHEMA` in `packages/core/src/manifest/schema.ts`. Do not edit manually. -->

Schema identifier: `https://aidrift.dev/schemas/aistate.v1.schema.json`

This reference describes the accepted YAML/JSON shape. Schema acceptance does not imply that every reserved feature is executable: unsupported storage, plugin, target, artifact, format, or hashing features fail closed at the command boundary. See the [README runtime contract](../../README.md) for the currently executable scope.

## Root object

| Property      | Shape                           | Required | Constraints                 |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `artifacts`   | object                          | yes      | unknown properties rejected |
| `description` | string                          | no       | —                           |
| `eval`        | object                          | yes      | unknown properties rejected |
| `name`        | string                          | yes      | minimum length 1            |
| `plugins`     | array of any of: string; object | no       | —                           |
| `storage`     | object                          | yes      | unknown properties rejected |
| `version`     | constant \`1\`                  | yes      | must equal \`1\`            |

## `eval`

Unknown properties are rejected.

| Property                | Shape                        | Required | Constraints                         |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `format`                | \`aidrift\` or \`promptfoo\` | no       | allowed: \`aidrift\`, \`promptfoo\` |
| `samples_per_assertion` | integer                      | no       | minimum 1; maximum 100              |
| `significance_level`    | number                       | no       | greater than 0; less than 1         |
| `suite`                 | string                       | yes      | minimum length 1                    |
| `target`                | one of: object; object       | no       | —                                   |
